summary: Mwenga territory sits on the south-western edge of the AFC/M23 zone in Sud-Kivu. The eastern part (Luhwindja chefferie / Mwana health zone with Twangiza) is assessed as held by M23 since its February 2025 advance from Bukavu and Walungu, and the RN2 corridor toward Mwenga centre (Kilungutwe–Kasika) as a contested frontline. Mwenga centre, Kamituga and the Kitutu gold area remain in the government camp but are dominated by Wazalendo/Mai-Mai and Raia Mutomboki groups alongside weakened FARDC and PNC. The Itombwe high plateaux (Minembwe, Mikenge, Bijojo) are held by M23-allied Twirwaneho since February 2025. Live web research was unavailable for this unit (search budget exhausted, news/UN sites blocked by the egress proxy), so all zones are low-confidence inferences from background knowledge up to mid-2026. Review (2026-10-01): the reviewer could not run independent web research either (search budget exhausted; Bing, Google, DuckDuckGo and ReliefWeb blocked by the egress proxy), so zones were checked only for internal and geographic consistency with the neighbouring Walungu, Shabunda, Uvira and Fizi assessments; no controller changes were made, the Luhwindja zone basis was lowered to inference and the RN2 frontline attribution flagged as unverified.

sources.title: Kivu Security Tracker (Mwenga territory: Mai-Mai/Raia Mutomboki, Twirwaneho, FARDC)
Radio Okapi coverage of Mwenga, Kamituga, Luhwindja and Minembwe (2025-2026)
UN Group of Experts on the DRC reports (2025)

zones.description: Luhwindja chefferie / Mwana health zone (Mwana–Twangiza area and its neighbourhoods, Buhamba, Cinjira, Buhuka) and Kimalanjala area east of Kilungutwe
zones.evidence: Luhwindja and the Twangiza mining area adjoin M23-held Walungu/Kaziba and were reported occupied by AFC/M23 after the February 2025 fall of Bukavu; Wazalendo raids from Burhinyi and western hills continued. No known recapture through the reference date. Reviewer: basis changed from area_report to inference because no dated report on Luhwindja/Twangiza could be consulted; the cited sources are generic index pages.

zones.description: RN2 corridor between Kaziba/Luhwindja and Mwenga centre: Kilungutwe, Kangola, Kalama, Kasika, Kadita, Muhuzi
zones.evidence: The Bukavu–Mwenga–Kamituga road (RN2) east of Mwenga centre has been a frontline between M23 pushing south-west from Walungu/Kaziba and Wazalendo/FARDC defending Mwenga since 2025; control of individual villages has shifted repeatedly. Reviewer: attribution of these RN2 villages to M23 rather than Wazalendo/FARDC is unverified; treat as a placeholder for the frontline.

zones.description: Mwenga centre (Kitamba) and the Mwenga health zone west of Kasika: Kalambi, Kigezi, Kitumba, Iganda, Butezi, Muzombo, Kibanda, Kananda
zones.evidence: The territorial seat remained in the government camp after February 2025; FARDC units retreating from Bukavu/Walungu regrouped toward Mwenga and Kamituga, where Mai-Mai/Wazalendo groups became the main armed force with their own roadblocks and taxation. Specific group not determined.

zones.description: Kamituga mining city (all neighbourhoods) and Kamituga health zone (Ngambo, Mangele, Lubigi Tongo, Biza, Kabeba, Kabumba, Musumba, Bungalama, Kankanga)
zones.evidence: Kamituga stayed outside M23 control; after the 2025 collapse of the eastern front FARDC remnants and Wazalendo/Mai-Mai groups (incl. Raia Mutomboki elements) dominate the town and mining sites, with reported indiscipline, extortion and clashes; PNC and administration remain present.

zones.description: Kitutu secteur / Kitutu health zone (Kabisa, Mission, Kabilongo, Katimbo, Kakemenge, Lubimbi, Kitutu–Mapale/Makalanga mining area, Matebo, Kasola, Mitembu)
zones.evidence: Kitutu borders Shabunda and has long hosted Raia Mutomboki/Mai-Mai factions taxing gold sites, now nominally Wazalendo; state presence limited to small posts in larger centres.

zones.description: Itombwe secteur high plateaux / Minembwe health zone and Bijojo: Minembwe Centre, Mikenge, Kilulwe, Magandi
zones.evidence: Twirwaneho, allied to AFC/M23, took Minembwe after FARDC withdrew in February 2025 and dominates the Banyamulenge high plateaux including Mikenge and Bijojo, while Mai-Mai/Wazalendo groups contest the surrounding forest and lowlands.

zones.description: Katonga (Mulombozi area, Itombwe lowlands toward Kitutu)
zones.evidence: Remote area of Itombwe secteur west of the plateaux in the Mwenga health zone; Mai-Mai/Wazalendo groups are the reported armed actors; no specific information.
